column3: The 1010 Pacific Subordination Agreement allows the HPD to appoint a replacement manager for the affordable housing units (and if it is not feasible to have a separate manager for the affordable housing units, then of all of the units) at the Mortgaged Property as a remedy for violation of the 1010 Pacific Declaration. Such manager is subject to the consent of the lender, not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
